notes: The UNR major is the BS in Computer Science and Engineering; the degree planner requires CS 135, 202, 219, 302, 326, 365, 425, 426, 446, 456 and 477. C3 is the algorithms course (CS 477); C4 is software engineering (CS 425). The course-site host cse.unr.edu refused connections during this session, so all four syllabi were read from Wayback Machine copies of the cited URLs. No syllabus from 2023 or later was found for any frame course. C5/C6 added: no 2023+ public syllabus found for either.
